follow-up time: From first trimester to within 6 weeks of delivery
exposure: Change in HbA1c levels throughout gestation
Glycosylated haemoglobin (HbA1c) levels in the first trimester
cohort: 396 pregnancies complicated by pregestational diabetes mellitus over a 10-year period
finding: Neither baseline HbA1c levels, pre-delivery values, nor trends across gestation appear to impact birthweight centile or mode of delivery in pregnancies complicated by PGDM.
mod_finding: Neither first trimester HbA1c levels, pre-delivery HbA1c levels, nor changes in HbA1c throughout gestation were correlated with mode of delivery in women with pregestational diabetes.
